verdict: Ads are generating business; tracking gaps are hiding the full picture.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads campaigns spent $1,110.70 and recorded 12 conversions, while your CRM shows 46 opportunities created and 17 won — a strong underlying signal. However, conversion tracking is disconnected from the ad platform, so reported lead counts read zero and do not reflect actual activity; this repair is already underway. Google ad spend also dropped 50% week-over-week, averaging $20.82 per day in the most recent seven days versus over $41 the week before, which pulled Google Business Profile engagement down alongside it. Heading into next period, LSA heating campaigns are scheduled to switch on September 1st, and several site additions — the Homer Glen branch page, financing page, and Review Boost campaign — are set to go live by August 31st.

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking is not connecting ad clicks to the leads your CRM is recording, causing lead counts to read zero in reporting.
watch_item.fix: Tracking is being repaired now so next period's numbers will reflect actual results; the CRM data confirms leads are coming in in the meantime.
